replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body:
Alright, YML can be found here.

I added two chests in each wool room, each filled with Sharpness I iron swords, Speed I potions, and golden apples. Download link has been updated as well. To prevent the game from being taken over by defenders who get millions of golden apples by killing rushers, the golden apples will not drop when a player dies, and the player will be rewarded one golden apple instead.
